essays.text: 人生的成長，有時是在一個瞬間。朱自清的〈背影〉描寫他看見年邁的父親在月台上，為了給他買橘子而奮力攀爬、蹣跚穿越鐵道的背影，讓作者瞬間體悟父愛而有所成長。龍應台在〈目送〉中，描寫自己一邊在目送孩子的「長大與遠離」，另一邊在目送父母的「老去與告別」，她處在兩個世代的夾縫之中，既是放手的母親，也是悲傷的女兒，讓她在一次次的目送中理解，成長其實是學會告別。在你的成長過程中，有哪些印象深刻的離別，其中的事件或是情感的衝擊，讓你在那個當下淘洗出生命的智慧，甚至與自己的生命達成和解，而變得更加成熟、通透事理了。請你以「別後的成長」為題，作文一篇，說明自身經驗中事件、情感衝擊的過程、始末及所獲得的省思與啟示。

mcq.q: The airline company wishes to apologize to its esteemed customers for the ____ caused by this diversion.
The nurse helped patients take a ____ to keep them clean and comfortable.
He felt ____ for signing the contract without reading all the terms carefully.
____ can be a result of various factors such as fear of the unknown, fear of making mistakes, or lack of confidence.
Judy’s sudden death after head injury was a terrible ____ for her family and friends.
We love to sit on the porch at ____, watching the sun slowly rising up in the sky.
Most of the prosperous countries in the world are ____ in northern hemisphere.
The horrible fire caused ____ damage to the historical church.
Mark’s ambitious business plan was built on the ____ that demand for electric cars would continue to grow.
The black box has been ____ from the crashed helicopter; it will help investigators determine the cause of the crash.

mcq.passage: Laika, a mixed-breed dog from Moscow, made history on November 3, 1957, as the first living creature to orbit Earth aboard the Soviet Union’s Sputnik 2. The mission was launched to 11 the anniversary of the Russian Revolution and aimed to assess spaceflight’s effects on living beings, shedding light on human space travel. Laika was selected 12 her obedience and resilience to extreme conditions. Originally named Kudryavka, she was placed in a specially designed pressurized cabin, which was equipped with life support and monitoring systems. However, the spacecraft was 13 for a return journey, meaning Laika’s mission was a one-way trip. While initial reports claimed that she survived for days, later findings revealed that she had died from overheating shortly after launch as a result of a thermal control system failure. The spacecraft then continued to orbit for months before it re-entered Earth’s atmosphere on April 14, 1958. 14 the tragic outcome, Laika’s mission provided valuable insights into how living organisms react to space environments. Her 15 played a crucial role in advancing human spaceflight, paving the way for future missions like Yuri Gagarin’s historic orbit in 1961. Today, Laika is remembered in various forms of media, including books, films, and memorials and has become a symbol of both scientific progress and the ethical debates surrounding animal testing in space exploration.

mcq.q: （題組第 16 題：依上方短文作答）
opts: A peculiar food which may not appeal to everyone.
An introduction to Swedish canning industry.
The correct way to have a“surströmmingsskiva.”
A popular influencer challenge on the YouTube.
mcq.passage: If you’ve come across one of the many "stinky fish challenge" videos on YouTube, it’s most likely the Swedish fermented fish “surströmmingsskiva” you’ve watched people (trying to) eat. Surströmming is a traditional dish from northern Sweden that arose during the 16th century when Sweden had a salt shortage. Today, the fish has become infamous due to its stinky smell, yet enthusiasts praise surströmming for its great taste. Surströmming is made from small Baltic herring caught in the spring. It is salted and left to ferment at leisure before being stuffed in a tin about a month before it hits the tables and shops. The fermentation process continues in the can–“souring”as the Swedes refer to it–and results in a bulging tin of fermented herring. Or rotten fish, as some (incorrectly) would say. The aroma is pungent, and the taste is rounded yet piquant with a distinct acidity. The fermentation originates from a lactic acid enzyme in the fish’s spine. The official fermented herring premiere (“surströmmingspremiär”) is on the third Thursday of August. However, late August until early September is a popular time to enjoy surströmming. In Alfta, Hälsingland, the world’s largest surströmming festival is arranged on August 16, 2025. It attracts traditionalist Swedes, food lovers and adventurist tourists. And, in more recent years, also influencers. Eating surströmming is a tradition and a social activity. Enthusiasts describe the taste as rich umami. It’s also an excuse to throw a fermented herring party, called“surströmmingsskiva.”Then how to eat surströmming like a local? As the tin is pressurized, always open the surströmming in a basin of water outdoor. Wash it, gut it, and wrap it in buttered“tunnbröd”(a type of sweetened flat bread) with slices of almond potatoes and diced onion. Accompany with beer, snaps and lots of friends. What is the main idea of this passage?

mcq.q: According to the passage, why does“surströmmingsskiva”get its strong flavor?
opts: It is made from a special small Baltic salmon.
It is rotten and gets sour due to carelessness.
It is fermented from a lactic acid enzyme.
It is purposely put in a bulging tin.

mcq.q: 常任文官違法侵害人民之權利，應依法律負一定責任，其責任不包括：
依司法院釋字第499號解釋，下列何者為不得修改之修憲界限？
下列何者是憲法本文明文保障預算編列比例下限，後經憲法增修條文第 10 條取消下限，而僅規定應優先編列之經費項目？
opts: 原住民族就學、就業、就醫等經費
婦女、兒童及身心障礙者之保障及扶助經費

mcq.q: 依憲法訴訟法規定，有關大法官之迴避，下列敘述何者正確？
opts: 大法官審理案件時應否迴避，準用行政訴訟法之規定
當事人向憲法法庭聲請大法官迴避時，得當庭以口頭提出
大法官曾參與原因案件之裁判，大法官應自行迴避
憲法法庭之書記官，準用行政訴訟法之迴避規定

mcq.q: 依司法院大法官解釋與憲法法庭判決，下列敘述何者錯誤？
opts: 政府於訂定街頭藝人從事藝文活動之相關許可法令時，除應維護一般人於公共空間之通常使用外，就特別使用之管制，亦應盡量採取無涉表意內容之管制
監獄對於受刑人發受之書信，仍得檢查以確認有無夾帶違禁品
人民使用無線廣播、電視或其他通訊傳播網路等設施之自由為憲法所保障
監獄長官只須基於維護監獄紀律之考量，即可禁止受刑人投稿報章雜誌

mcq.q: 依司法院大法官解釋，有關兵役體位判定，下列敘述何者錯誤？
opts: 兵役體位判定對役男在憲法上權益有重大影響
僅能提起申訴，不得提起訴願或行政訴訟
免役應先經主管機關之核定及複核，並未限制人民爭訟之權利
兵役體位的判定對人民基本權利產生具體影響而為行政處分

mcq.q: 依大法官解釋及憲法法庭判決，個人於公開場域活動受隱私權保障的判斷標準為何？
關於立法院之調查權，下列敘述何者錯誤？
opts: 立法院為有效行使憲法所賦予之職權，自得享有全面完整之調查權
立法院行使調查權，得經院會決議，要求與調查事項相關之政府人員陳述意見
立法院調查權之事項，必須與其行使憲法所賦予之職權有重大關聯性且必要者
立法院行使調查權如涉及行政特權，應予以適當尊重

mcq.q: 有關監察院審計權之組織及運作，下列敘述何者錯誤？
opts: 監察院設審計長，由總統提名，經立法院同意任命之
審計長應於行政院提出決算後3個月內，依法完成其審核，並提出審核報告於立法院
行政院於會計年度結束後4個月內，應提出決算於監察院
審計長及審計人員，依法直接受監察委員命令及監督

mcq.q: 有關地方自治保障的憲法訴訟，下列敘述何者正確？
opts: 地方自治團體之立法機關，因行使職權，認所應適用之中央法規範牴觸憲法，對其受憲法所保障之地方自治權有造成損害之虞者，得聲請憲法法庭為宣告違憲之判決
地方自治團體如認其自治條例被監督機關函告無效，係屬違憲，得直接聲請憲法法庭判決
地方自治團體之立法機關議決之自治事項，經監督機關函告無效，得直接聲請憲法法庭判決
地方自治團體之自治條例經法院宣告無效後，得直接聲請憲法法庭判決
